children: Radiant Logistics, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $934.4M and net income of $18.8M attributable to the company, with diluted earnings per share of $0.39, reflecting modest top-line growth and improved per-share earnings versus fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $934.4M, compared with $902.7M in the prior year; YoY change 3.5%.
Net income was $18.8M, compared with $17.3M in the prior year; YoY change 8.6%.
Diluted EPS was $0.39, compared with $0.35 in the prior year; YoY change 11.4%.
Transportation revenue increased 3.3% year over year to $882.8M, driven by acquisitions and higher volumes across the network.
Value-added services expanded to $51.6M, supported by stronger Canadian warehouse operations.
Radiant continued to develop a multi-brand network spanning more than 100 locations, including about 30 company-owned sites and increased strategic partner density.

Management noted operational efficiency gains, with improved adjusted gross profit and lower depreciation and amortization, while focusing on technology consolidation and transportation management system (TMS) integration.
